## Acronyms {.unnumbered .unlisted}


## YAML keys {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- `A`: Arrhenius pre-exponential factor, input in molecule, cm, s units; default 1 in internal units; converted by `convert_from`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L84-L93). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `b`: exponent of the temperature ratio in the Arrhenius rate; default 0; stored in option `b`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L95). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `composition`: map from element symbol to count; the molar mass is computed from it; passed to `molar_mass`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L165-L170). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `cv_R`: reference heat capacity at constant volume divided by the gas constant; default 5/2; stored in `species_cref_R`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L172-L176). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `diameter`: length whose square divides the evaporation rate coefficient; default 1e-2; stored in option `diameter`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/evaporation.cpp#L103). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `diff_c`: evaporation diffusivity at the reference state, mol-m-s units; default 2e-5; stored in option `diff_c`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/evaporation.cpp#L99). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `diff_P`: exponent of the pressure ratio in the evaporation diffusivity; default -1; stored in option `diff_P`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/evaporation.cpp#L101). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `diff_T`: exponent of the temperature ratio in the evaporation diffusivity; default 1.75; stored in option `diff_T`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/evaporation.cpp#L100). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `dzi`: distances between neighbouring level centres on the N-1 inner faces, argument of `diffusion_coefficients`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/diffusion/diffusion.cpp#L12-L20). Defined in [The eddy-diffusion operator on a column (`diffusion_coefficients`)](#sec-ch08-operator).
- `Ea_R`: activation energy divided by the gas constant, in K; default 1 K in the Arrhenius reader; stored in option `Ea_R`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L96). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `equation`: reaction string; => irreversible, <=> or = reversible; required; parsed by `Reaction`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L64-L68). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `formula`: name of the saturation vapour pressure function of a nucleation or evaporation entry; required; stored in `logsvp`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/thermo/nucleation.cpp#L68-L72). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `Kzz`: eddy diffusion coefficient on the N-1 inner faces of a column, argument of `diffusion_coefficients`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/diffusion/diffusion.cpp#L12-L20). Defined in [The eddy-diffusion operator on a column (`diffusion_coefficients`)](#sec-ch08-operator).
- `name`: species name, the key every other block uses; required; stored in `species_names`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L156). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `Pref`: reference pressure in Pa; kinetics default 101325 Pa, thermodynamics default 1e5 Pa; kinetics option `Pref`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/kinetics_options.cpp#L51-L52). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `rate-constant`: map of the rate parameters of one reaction entry; read as `rxn_node["rate-constant"]`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L76-L79). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `reactions`: top-level list of reactions, one map per reaction; read by `ArrheniusOptionsImpl::from_yaml` and the other readers; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/kinetics_options.cpp#L66-L69). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `reference-state`: map of reference constants (Tref, Pref, use-nasa9-cp, use-h2-cp, h2-cp-mode); unknown keys are refused; checked by `check_reference_state`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L231-L246). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `species`: list of species maps; required; its order fixes the species index; read by `init_species_from_yaml`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L148-L155). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `Tref`: reference temperature in K; kinetics default 298.15 K, thermodynamics default 300 K; kinetics option `Tref`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/kinetics_options.cpp#L40-L41). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `type`: name of the rate form; each reader keeps the entries of its own type; required; compared with the reader `name()`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp#L58-L62). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
- `u0_R`: reference internal energy divided by the gas constant, in K; default 0; stored in `species_uref_R`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L178-L182). Defined in [The YAML input file: species and reference state (`species`, `reference-state`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-input).
- `vm`: volume factor of the evaporation rate coefficient; default 1.8e-5; stored in option `vm`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/kinetics/evaporation.cpp#L102). Defined in [The reaction list and its rate-parameter keys (`reactions`)](#sec-ch11-yaml-reactions).
